name: Selected Topics in Scientific Computing and High Performance Computing
description:
Master students in Informatics may choose this module only once as an elective module in the field of Algorithms and Scientific Computing (AWR).

This year, the topic will be on space and time discretization methods, covering in particular an understanding on time integration methods for solving PDEs. This course will be given by Dr. Martin Schreiber (maybe invited speakers) with the content planned as follows:

- Basics
-- Basics of ordinary differential equations
-- Basics of standard time integration (Runge-Kutta)
-- Space discretization
-- Partial differential equations (PDEs)
-- Discretization of PDE operators
- Advanced time integration methods
-- Dispersion properties
-- Splitting methods
-- Semi-Lagrangian Methods
-- Spectral Deferred Correction Methods
-- Exponential time integration
-- Parareal
-- Parallel Full Approximation Scheme in Space and Time (PFASST)
prerequisites: Bachelor in Informatics (Interest in NumProg is an essential prerequisite)
